QBR — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), Q1 2025. Account owner: Marcus Trent.~~NL~~Tense call. The Jan 14-16 Chicago storm delayed a large batch of Jaffle Equipment freight (a representative affected shipment is linked on this note) and the client raised the jackknife incident (INC-2025-00417) directly. On-time for January will breach the 97.0% target. Client asked, pointedly, whether Jaffle Logistics can handle their peak volumes. Committed to an SLA credit per contract CON-0042-01 and a written recovery plan. Sentiment concerned; first real crack in the relationship this year.

QBR — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), Q1 2025. Account owner: Marcus Trent.~~NL~~Q1 review with Jaffle Equipment. January storm credit applied and closed out. On-time recovering but still below the 97% target. Client cautious but constructive. Watching. Contract CON-0042-01.

ACCOUNT SAVE PLAN — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), contract CON-0042-01.~~NL~~Situation: strategic LTL account degraded from healthy to at-risk over 2025. Root causes: the January Chicago storm (INC-2025-00417), a summer run of late loads, and rising support-ticket volume without a systemic fix.~~NL~~Plan: (1) dedicated CHI capacity for Jaffle Equipment freight during peak; (2) weekly on-time scorecard shared with the client; (3) executive sponsor check-in; (4) goodwill credit beyond contractual minimums.
